name: dsh-plugin-visual-curator
description: Versioned visual styles, human feedback, image search and reviewed crops for DSH

prompt.en: Use visual_style_list to show saved visual styles and published versions. Read existing data only.
prompt.zh: 请用 visual_style_list 查看已保存的视觉风格和发布版本，只读取已有数据。

prompt.en: Read an existing Visual Curator task using visual_run_get. Explain its status and review results without starting a task or changing feedback.
prompt.zh: 请用 visual_run_get 查看一个已有视觉策展任务，说明任务状态和复核结果，不启动新任务或修改反馈。

description.en: Read reference dimensions, style rules and fixed releases.
description.zh: 读取参考维度、风格规则与固定发布版本。

details.en: References apply only to their selected dimensions. Drafts are not executable standards. This skill provides instructions; it does not import images or publish styles.
details.zh: 参考图只影响明确指定的维度；草稿不会作为正式搜图标准。此技能提供操作指引，不会自动导入图片或发布风格。

description.en: Inspect rule evidence, conflicts and proposed calibration.
description.zh: 检查规则依据、冲突和待确认的校准建议。

details.en: Distinguish requirements, preferences and reference-only rules, with explicit evidence and exceptions. Humans confirm rules and publish releases.
details.zh: 保持硬性规则、偏好与参考规则的区别，明确例外和证据。规则修改与版本发布始终由人工确认。

description.en: Search with a published standard and inspect visual reviews.
description.zh: 按已发布标准检索图片并读取视觉筛选结果。

details.en: Requires curation tools, an image source and a vision model. Runs pin style, usage and budgets without weakening rules to fill quotas.
details.zh: 需要启用找图与裁图工具并配置图片来源与视觉模型。任务固定风格版本、用途版本和预算，不为凑数量放宽规则。

description.en: Specify usage and protected content, then review rendered crops.
description.zh: 指定比例与保护内容，复核实际裁后画面。

details.en: Uses authorized saved images and fixed usage revisions. sharp renders each crop before vision review; automated results are not human confirmations.
details.zh: 使用已有授权图片和固定用途版本，由 sharp 实际裁剪，再由视觉模型复核。自动结果不会成为人工确认。

description.en: Organize visual differences, feedback dimensions and suggestions.
description.zh: 整理视觉差异、反馈维度与待人工确认建议。

details.en: Agent suggestions retain authorship and scope. They do not become human labels, modify published versions or silently change later searches.
details.zh: Agent 只提交未确认建议，保留原始作者与任务范围。反馈不会自动修改已发布版本，也不会直接改变后续找图标准。

title.zh: 数据集与 Skill 导出

description.en: Export reviewed data with fixed versions, splits and permissions.
description.zh: 按固定版本、数据划分和授权导出复核数据。

details.en: Uses existing confirmed labels and saved splits. Exports references by default. A Skill is a downloadable guide, not automatic installation or model training.
details.zh: 只使用已有人工确认标签与保存的数据划分，默认导出引用。Skill 是可下载的指导文档，不会自动安装或训练模型。

description.zh: 读取风格、任务与导出记录。

details.en: Provides visual_task_prepare, visual_style_list, visual_style_get, visual_run_get and visual_export_get. Preparation starts no job or paid request. Disabling removes these five tools without deleting data.
details.zh: 提供 visual_task_prepare、visual_style_list、visual_style_get、visual_run_get 和 visual_export_get。任务准备不会启动任务或调用付费接口；关闭后撤销这五项 Agent 工具，不删除已保存的数据。

description.en: Start searches and crops against a fixed style.
description.zh: 启动按固定风格执行的找图和裁图任务。

details.en: Provides visual_search_start and visual_crop_start. Search requires a source and vision model; cropping requires a vision model and renders with sharp. Disabling removes new Agent starts; existing tasks remain.
details.zh: 提供 visual_search_start 和 visual_crop_start。找图需要来源与视觉模型，裁图需要视觉模型，复用 sharp 输出实际图片。关闭后不接受新的 Agent 启动请求；已有任务保留。

description.en: Save Agent suggestions and export existing reviewed data.
description.zh: 保存 Agent 建议，导出已有人工复核数据。

details.en: Provides visual_feedback_suggest and visual_export_start. Does not confirm human labels, publish styles, install Skills or train models. Image-byte exports require prior permission.
details.zh: 提供 visual_feedback_suggest 和 visual_export_start。不会自动确认人工标签、发布风格、安装 Skill 或训练模型；导出图片字节必须已有授权。

description.en: Show a Visual Curator entry in Settings.
description.zh: 在设置中显示视觉策展入口。

details.en: Opens the reference-style workbench for model configuration, image recognition, style-guided search and dataset or Skill export. Off by default; hiding an entry does not delete data or stop tasks.
details.zh: 打开参考风格工作台，可配置模型、识别图片、按风格找图及导出数据集或 Skill。默认关闭；关闭入口不会删除数据或停止后台任务。

description.en: Show a Visual Curator entry in the home sidebar.
description.zh: 在首页侧栏显示视觉策展入口。

details.en: Opens the reference-style workbench for model configuration, image recognition, style-guided search and dataset or Skill export. Off by default; hiding an entry does not delete data or stop tasks.
details.zh: 打开参考风格工作台，可配置模型、识别图片、按风格找图及导出数据集或 Skill。默认关闭；关闭入口不会删除数据或停止后台任务。

description.en: Show a Visual Curator tab in conversations.
description.zh: 在会话中显示视觉策展标签。

details.en: Opens the reference-style workbench for model configuration, image recognition, style-guided search and dataset or Skill export. Off by default; hiding an entry does not delete data or stop tasks.
details.zh: 打开参考风格工作台，可配置模型、识别图片、按风格找图及导出数据集或 Skill。默认关闭；关闭入口不会删除数据或停止后台任务。

scripts.prepack: pnpm run check && pnpm run build
